model: pi-0.5 (Physical Intelligence pi0.5 vision-language-action policy, lerobot/pi05_base)
name: pi05-base-p150
task: images + language instruction (+ normalised state) -> 50-step chunk of 32-dim normalised actions (flow matching, Euler, on device)
hardware: Tenstorrent Blackhole, single chip (mesh 1x1) via tt-nn; fused whole-graph sample_actions_fused: traced stock-ttnn SigLIP / VLM prefix + the phase-1 expert megakernel (ONE persistent generic_op for the whole 10-step action expert loop), one Metal trace

inputs.image_preprocess: RGB, bilinear squash-resize to 224x224 (no aspect padding), /255, (x-0.5)/0.5
inputs.prompt_format: Task: <prompt>, State: b0 ... b31;\nAction:  (state discretised into 256 bins over [-1,1])
inputs.state_semantics: normalised [-1,1] QUANTILES space; enters the model only through the prompt (pi0.5)

batch.note: concurrent requests are batched into one traced forward (padded to the next configured size)

outputs.note: lerobot QUANTILES-normalised actions padded to 32 dims; pi05_base ships no per-feature stats, so denormalise with your dataset's action q01/q99 and slice to your action dim
